item.title: Grafana Labs: Degradation of Hosted Grafana in US Central Region [identified]

item.title: Ingage: シングルサインオンにてユーザー登録ができない [resolved]
item.description:
シングルサインオン（SSO）設定環境において、特定の条件の場合に新規ユーザーの登録が行えない問題が発生しておりましたが、現在は対応が完了し復旧したためご連絡いたします。
【影響のあった環境】 以下に該当する場合に、シングルサインオン（SSO）経由で新規ユーザーの作成ができませんでした。 ・閲覧ユーザー、AI社員、ユーザーの合計人数がユーザー登録上限に達していた場合
【現在の状況と対応】 システムの修正対応を適用し、現在はシングルサインオン経由でも正常に新規登録が行えることを確認しております。
お客様にはご不便とご心配をおかけしましたことを、お詫び申し上げます。

item.title: Akamai Edge DNS: Certificate Provisioning System (CPS) Issues and Network Connectivity Issues in Atlanta Region [resolved]
item.description: We became aware of an issue with a network component related to connectivity in the Atlanta, GA region which impacted the Certificate Provisioning System as well as potential impact to other Edge traffic through the region. The issue lasted between 12:21 UTC and 14:19 UTC on September 4, 2026. We can confirm that the issue is now resolved, and the service has resumed normal operation. Customers and partners can view additional details about the incident by logging in to: or reaching out to Akamai Support. We apologize for the impact and thank you for your patience and continued support. We are committed to making continuous improvements to make our systems better and prevent a recurrence of this issue.

item.title: Moveworks: Unable to send messages to the AI Assistant on MS Teams [identified]
item.description:
Workaround Available
We have identified that, for some affected customers, the Available to setting for the Moveworks bot in the Microsoft Teams admin centre is set to No one. Restoring the appropriate availability has resolved the issue for some customers.
Teams administrators can update this setting by following these steps:
1. Sign in to the Microsoft Teams admin centre. 2. Go to Teams apps → Manage apps and select the Moveworks bot. 3. Open the Users and groups tab. Alternatively, select No one (org-wide default) if it appears as a link. 4. Under Availability, select Edit availability. 5. Change Available to from No one to one of the following:
Everyone — Select this if all users in the tenant should have access to the bot. This is the most common setting for Moveworks deployments.
